knownIssues.symptom: Does not launch: the EA app installer Steam runs first ends with Something went wrong (INST-14-1603 or INST-14-1627)
The game loads for two and a half to four minutes after its splash, then quits (exit code 0xFFFFFFFA) on DXMT, D3DMetal and DXVK alike (reported on an M1, macOS 27.0.1, Wine 11 r27, highball-db#318)

notes: The upstream record does not specify a renderer. DXMT is the starting default.
